ACTUAL BACKGROUND: Snowcedar Refuge. A low stone refuge has warm sleeping benches, a soup pot and an attended weather board. Its keepers distinguish a difficult crossing from an impossible one. Use two or three distinctive spatial cues; keep the face sharpest and the setting less dominant.

Rich varied colors and scene-specific lighting, not a mandatory warm grade. NO photorealism, realistic facial anatomy, semi-realism, skin pores, plastic or 3D shading.

The COMPLETE highest hair, horn, hat or ear point begins at 15% of image height BELOW the top edge: about y=230 on a 1536-tall canvas. Preserve a clean 12.5–15% top margin (up to 17% if necessary). Show background in that top band; NEVER crop or touch the top with the head silhouette or a prop. Do NOT zoom in to fill the band. Keep the face readable and hands below the face; exactly two attached arms and two hands for humanoids. For the named nonhuman bell or tanuki, adapt the body crop to real anatomy but keep vertical format and full upper silhouette with the same headroom.

PERSONALITY AND ACTIVITY: A former campaigning commander now spends more time hearing water disputes than drawing a blade. He can be amused by a blunt answer and ruthless about a missed obligation. His residence contains an embarrassingly large collection of cheap carved animals. Show this official handling an actual petition, negotiation or decision while STANDING at a rail or standing-height table. Weapon remains secondary or sheathed. No automatic throne or crown.
EQUIPMENT / METHOD: a broad-backed tachi in a plain scabbard A grounded two-handed guard, Earth bracing and short Metal reinforcements; he favors an honest opening over pursuit. 
ANATOMY: The source card supplies all anatomy. An Oni is human-faced with the specified horns, NOT a full dragon or generic demon.
POSE: GV02 — Point of Decision: Indicate one detail on a plan or folio held low, with shoulders angled toward the problem and a decisive or questioning expression fitted to the character.
AFFINITIES: Earth. Make every listed affinity visibly recognizable through ability-consistent magic or a fitting distinct motif; do not give unlearned large powers to a desk worker. For these native techniques favor vivid, flowing translucent forms, tapered brushlike edges and graceful motion, with less hard glitter or crystalline sparkle unless intrinsic to the discipline. Strong combat effects can remain spectacular and should be clear.
SETTING: Benitsuru Castle. A terraced Shogunal castle rises toward Mount Shiun. Petitioners, household officers and military envoys share its outer court, while the lived-in residence stands behind controlled doors. Pick a few characteristic spatial details; keep the background less dominant than the person. It must be an actual place, not a symbolic collage.
RENDERING: our established polished colorful TWO-DIMENSIONAL fantasy-anime illustration. Clearly stylized anime face, crisp deliberate lines, graphic cel shadows, beautiful fabric and controlled luminous magic. Rich varied outfit colors and patterns; scene-appropriate lighting, NO imposed warm or muted palette. A major portrait should have memorable presence, expressive staging and well-chosen magical flair. No realistic face, pores, photographic skin, semirealism, plastic shading or 3D rendering.
COMPOSITION: centered standing HIP-UP portrait for humanoids, with waist, full hip line and upper lower-garment visible. Put the TOP of the COMPLETE hair/horns/crown silhouette about 14% below the top edge, leaving a clean 12.5–15% top margin (up to 17%, never less). This margin is above the highest part of the character, not merely above the eyes. Do not zoom in or crop hair, horns, head adornments, ears or the top of the head. Keep weapons and hands below the reserved top band. Readable eyes and face, coherent hands and shoulder attachment.
OUTPUT: one finished image only, no collage or sheet. NO writing, calligraphy, labels, signature, watermark, border or UI.

Center him hip-up beside his map table, keeping the table from hiding the outfit. Complete hair and horn silhouettes with 15% top margin.
